axebozo: The new rifleman gave his name as Oskar Axebozo. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.
First Wave. Oskar Axebozo signed when the posters were still wet. He keeps the ribbon wrapped in oilcloth with a key to a house that is no longer there.
Oskar Axebozo reported for duty as a chaplain. The new kit was heavier than the explanation of how to use it.
The new soap slipped into the wash bucket. Oskar Axebozo recovered it by touch and then had to wash again.

Oskar Axebozo was asked to arrange a gathering for men who did not want a sermon. He asked what they did want and wrote down the answers. Verdel Ridge is lost. Oskar Axebozo heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
hackermt90: Otto Hackermt joined the replacements on Day 3. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name. News of the loss of Verdel Ridge reached S-F5 with the rations. Otto Hackermt ate while listening to the revised orders.
theramblingbot: Nobody asked Emil Theramblingb why he came. Nobody in S-F16 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.

Emil Theramblingb tried writing with gloves on. The address is readable. Everything else will require imagination. Verdel Ridge is in Concord hands. Emil Theramblingb stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
